headline: Small ESE windswell, clean at dawn then crossed out.
today: About 2ft at a short 4s on a good ESE angle, with cross-off NE early before the wind goes cross E for the day. Dawn is your only clean look — after that it's textured and mushy. Log it or stay home.

daysToWatch.note: Chest-high ESE with offshore N in the morning — cleanest small day of the week here. Worth a dawn check.
Flat but offshore and pretty. Not much to ride.
